app/test-carousel/page.tsx.name: Carousel preview page
app/test-carousel/page.tsx.description: Opens a standalone test page to preview how the horizontal product carousel looks and scrolls.

app/tmc-review/match/page.tsx.name: Supplier match page
app/tmc-review/match/page.tsx.description: Opens the screen where staff pair each existing Elysium product with the matching ring from TMC's catalogue.

app/tmc-review/match/ReviewMatch.tsx.name: Supplier match tool
app/tmc-review/match/ReviewMatch.tsx.description: Lets staff search TMC's catalogue, pick the matching ring for each Elysium product, and save the pairing.

app/tmc-review/page.tsx.name: Supplier review page
app/tmc-review/page.tsx.description: Opens the screen where staff review every ring in TMC's catalogue and decide which ones to sell.

app/tmc-review/ReviewClient.tsx.name: Supplier ring reviewer
app/tmc-review/ReviewClient.tsx.description: Lets staff browse TMC's full ring list, set a display name and price, add notes, and mark each ring to keep or skip.

lib/tmc/client-actions.ts.name: Review follow-up helpers
lib/tmc/client-actions.ts.description: Formats and tracks follow-up questions between staff and the supplier during the ring review process.

lib/tmc/notify-review.ts.name: Review notification sender
lib/tmc/notify-review.ts.description: Sends an email and a notification to the team whenever a ring review decision is saved.

lib/tmc/review-fallback.ts.name: Review backup data
lib/tmc/review-fallback.ts.description: Loads a saved snapshot of review decisions so the tool still works when the database is temporarily unavailable.
